description: This script orchestrates a comprehensive stress testing suite for OpenSSL components. It defines multiple functions to run various OpenSSL tests (e.g., BIO, DSA, TLS, RSA, etc.) in parallel, captures system metrics, and logs the results. The script manages test execution timing, resource monitoring, and sequentially runs different test categories with specified concurrency levels.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command multiple times in parallel, redirecting output to /dev/null.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and script basename to the log file.

methods.name: stress_cipher_function
methods.description: Runs cipher list and bytes tests.

methods.name: stress_err_function
methods.description: Runs error and fatal error tests.

methods.name: stress_evp_function
methods.description: Runs EVP encryption, digest, and key derivation tests.

methods.name: execute_ui_test
methods.description: Performs UI stress testing with timing and resource monitoring.

methods.name: execute_bio_test
methods.description: Performs BIO stress testing with timing and resource monitoring.

methods.name: execute_dsa_test
methods.description: Performs DSA stress testing with timing and resource monitoring.

methods.name: execute_tls_test
methods.description: Performs TLS/DTLS stress testing with timing and resource monitoring.

methods.name: execute_cipher_test
methods.description: Performs cipher list and bytes tests with timing and resource monitoring.

methods.name: execute_err_test
methods.description: Performs error and fatal error tests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test suite, runs all tests sequentially, and logs total execution time.
